tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-ink-primary) l c calc(h * 0.9 + var(--primary-hue) * 0.1))

tokens.name: --color-success
tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-neon-green) var(--state-target-lightness) calc(c * var(--state-chroma-scale)) h)

tokens.name: --color-warning
tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-neon-orange) var(--state-target-lightness) calc(c * var(--state-chroma-scale)) h)

tokens.name: --color-error
tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-neon-red) var(--state-target-lightness) calc(c * var(--state-chroma-scale)) h)

tokens.name: --color-info
tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-neon-blue) var(--state-target-lightness) calc(c * var(--state-chroma-scale)) h)

tokens.name: --color-accent
tokens.value: oklch(from var(--color-primary) l calc(c * 0.91) calc(h - var(--accent-hue-offset)))

tokens.name: --inset-shadow-highlight
tokens.value: inset 0 1px oklch(from var(--color-shadow-surface-base) l c h / 0.3)

tokens.name: --inset-shadow-highlight-pressed
